# GHSL urban-centre density adaptation

European Union / European Commission Joint Research Centre, GHS Urban Centre Database R2024A V1.2, 2025 estimates. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Source: https://human-settlement.emergency.copernicus.eu/ghs_ucdb_2024.php
Specific package and explicit copyright notice: https://jeodpp.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ftp/jrc-opendata/GHSL/GHS_UCDB_GLOBE_R2024A/GHS_UCDB_THEME_GLOBE_R2024A/GHS_UCDB_THEME_GENERAL_CHARACTERISTICS_GLOBE_R2024A/V1-2/

Adaptation by Comfy Days: population divided by urban-centre area; GeoNames city points joined to containing polygons; reduced and compressed fields. Not municipal density. Not endorsed by the European Commission. GeoNames catalogue attribution remains CC BY 4.0.
